The '''Mind Walkers,''' also known as '''Mind Drinkers,''' were a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who lived at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. There, they learned how to separate their minds from their bodies to enter a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]].

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|We Mind Walkers come from a great many traditions. The Disciples of Ragnos, the Fallanassi, the Jensaarai, the Potentium Heretics, the Reborn, the Far Seekers, the Inner Seers and ten dozen more.|Seek Ryontarr, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
Mind Walkers were a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] living at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. They learned how to separate their minds from their bodies in order to go to a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] called [[beyond shadows]]. The Mind Walkers did not originate from a single Force-tradition, but from many various traditions. Each tradition brought understanding; however, they all felt that their former sects did not understand the truth, as they came to believe that everything but the Force was an illusion. They first came to that belief following the destruction of [[Centerpoint Station]]. While traveling beyond shadows, however, it was impossible to keep track of time and the Mind Walkers were unable to take care of their bodies, so they often became very malnourished, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force Sustenance|sustain]] themselves.

==History==
The Mind Walkers lived on Sinkhole Station, a space station in the Maw very similar in appearance to [[Centerpoint Station]]. The [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] were aware of this group, and disapproved of them, calling them "Mind Drinkers." After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] met with the Mind Walkers and traveled beyond shadows with them during his five year sojourn. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], who had embarked on a quest to retrace the steps Solo took during his travels in order to find out more about his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], traveled to Sinkhole Station to meet with the Mind Walkers.

While with the Mind Walkers, the two Skywalkers traveled beyond shadows, where they were shown many places, including the [[Font of Power]], the [[Pool of Knowledge]], and the [[Lake of Apparitions]], where they met with the deceased spirits of Jedi [[Anakin Solo]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and Jacen Solo.

==Behind the scenes==
In an allusion to [[Wikipedia:Odyssey|The Odyssey]], the Mind Walkers who Luke and Ben meet resemble the [[Wikipedia:Lotus-eaters|Lotus-eaters]] encountered by [[Wikipedia:Odysseus|Odysseus]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
